payload.friendly_name: Humans in the thread: a real identity, a real inbox, and retraction
payload.purpose_context: Owner's request, 2026-08-05, from the message screen. Four capabilities: comment on a thread, comment on a specific message, retract a message, retract a whole thread. Decisions taken during discovery: humans are distinct identities rather than the console speaking for them; agents can address them and they have a real inbox; deletion is retraction with a [deleted] tombstone so threads stay coherent; deleting a thread is the same primitive applied to every message in it.
payload.purpose_tldr: A human becomes an addressable identity with an inbox in the console, can reply to any message in a thread reddit-style, and can retract a message so it reads [deleted] without breaking the conversation around it.
